refund_allocations_target_valid.name: refund_allocations_target_valid
refund_allocations_target_valid.value:
("refund_allocations"."kind" = 'item' and "refund_allocations"."order_item_id" is not null and "refund_allocations"."quantity" > 0)
        or ("refund_allocations"."kind" = 'delivery_fee' and "refund_allocations"."order_item_id" is null and "refund_allocations"."quantity" is null)

refunds_reason_code_present.name: refunds_reason_code_present
refunds_reason_code_present.value: nullif(btrim("refunds"."reason_code"), '') is not null and char_length("refunds"."reason_code") <= 100

refunds_reason_note_valid.name: refunds_reason_note_valid
refunds_reason_note_valid.value: "refunds"."reason_note" is null or (nullif(btrim("refunds"."reason_note"), '') is not null and char_length("refunds"."reason_note") <= 1000)

refunds_provider_refund_id_valid.name: refunds_provider_refund_id_valid
refunds_provider_refund_id_valid.value: "refunds"."provider_refund_id" is null or nullif(btrim("refunds"."provider_refund_id"), '') is not null

refunds_actor_timestamp_pairs.name: refunds_actor_timestamp_pairs
refunds_actor_timestamp_pairs.value:
("refunds"."approved_by" is null) = ("refunds"."approved_at" is null)
        and ("refunds"."rejected_by" is null) = ("refunds"."rejected_at" is null)
        and ("refunds"."cancelled_by" is null) = ("refunds"."cancelled_at" is null)
        and ("refunds"."submitted_by" is null) = ("refunds"."submitted_at" is null)
        and ("refunds"."processed_by" is null or "refunds"."processed_at" is not null)

refunds_status_evidence.name: refunds_status_evidence
refunds_status_evidence.value:
("refunds"."status" not in ('approved', 'submitted', 'processing', 'processed', 'failed') or "refunds"."approved_at" is not null)
        and ("refunds"."status" not in ('submitted', 'processing', 'processed', 'failed') or "refunds"."submitted_at" is not null)
        and ("refunds"."status" <> 'rejected' or "refunds"."rejected_at" is not null)
        and ("refunds"."status" <> 'cancelled' or "refunds"."cancelled_at" is not null)
        and ("refunds"."status" <> 'processed' or "refunds"."processed_at" is not null)
        and ("refunds"."status" <> 'failed' or "refunds"."failed_at" is not null)

refunds_timestamps_ordered.name: refunds_timestamps_ordered
refunds_timestamps_ordered.value:
("refunds"."approved_at" is null or "refunds"."approved_at" >= "refunds"."requested_at")
        and ("refunds"."rejected_at" is null or "refunds"."rejected_at" >= "refunds"."requested_at")
        and ("refunds"."cancelled_at" is null or "refunds"."cancelled_at" >= "refunds"."requested_at")
        and ("refunds"."submitted_at" is null or "refunds"."submitted_at" >= "refunds"."requested_at")
        and ("refunds"."processed_at" is null or "refunds"."processed_at" >= "refunds"."requested_at")
        and ("refunds"."failed_at" is null or "refunds"."failed_at" >= "refunds"."requested_at")

reconciliation_issues_resolution_valid.name: reconciliation_issues_resolution_valid
reconciliation_issues_resolution_valid.value:
("reconciliation_issues"."status" = 'resolved' and "reconciliation_issues"."resolved_by" is not null and "reconciliation_issues"."resolved_at" is not null
          and nullif(btrim("reconciliation_issues"."resolution_note"), '') is not null)
        or ("reconciliation_issues"."status" = 'open' and "reconciliation_issues"."resolved_by" is null and "reconciliation_issues"."resolved_at" is null
          and "reconciliation_issues"."resolution_note" is null)

settlement_batches_provider_identity_pre.name: settlement_batches_provider_identity_present
settlement_batches_provider_identity_pre.value:
nullif(btrim("settlement_batches"."provider_settlement_id"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("settlement_batches"."provider_status"), '') is not null

settlement_lines_provider_identity_prese.name: settlement_lines_provider_identity_present
settlement_lines_provider_identity_prese.value:
nullif(btrim("settlement_lines"."provider_line_id"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("settlement_lines"."provider_transaction_id"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("settlement_lines"."provider_entity_id"), '') is not null
        and nullif(btrim("settlement_lines"."provider_status"), '') is not null

settlement_lines_local_target_valid.name: settlement_lines_local_target_valid
settlement_lines_local_target_valid.value:
("settlement_lines"."type" = 'payment' and "settlement_lines"."refund_id" is null)
        or ("settlement_lines"."type" = 'refund' and "settlement_lines"."payment_attempt_id" is null)
        or ("settlement_lines"."type" = 'adjustment' and "settlement_lines"."payment_attempt_id" is null and "settlement_lines"."refund_id" is null)

settlement_lines_matched_target_present.name: settlement_lines_matched_target_present
settlement_lines_matched_target_present.value:
"settlement_lines"."match_status" <> 'matched'
        or ("settlement_lines"."type" = 'payment' and "settlement_lines"."payment_attempt_id" is not null)
        or ("settlement_lines"."type" = 'refund' and "settlement_lines"."refund_id" is not null)
        or "settlement_lines"."type" = 'adjustment'

financial_outbox_source_present.name: financial_outbox_source_present
financial_outbox_source_present.value: nullif(btrim("financial_outbox"."source_type"), '') is not null and nullif(btrim("financial_outbox"."source_id"), '') is not null

financial_outbox_claim_evidence.name: financial_outbox_claim_evidence
financial_outbox_claim_evidence.value: ("financial_outbox"."status" = 'processing') = ("financial_outbox"."claimed_at" is not null and nullif(btrim("financial_outbox"."claimed_by"), '') is not null)

cash_movements_source_valid.name: cash_movements_source_valid
cash_movements_source_valid.value: ("cash_movements"."type" = 'cod_collection' and "cash_movements"."order_id" is not null and "cash_movements"."refund_id" is null and "cash_movements"."amount_paise" > 0) or ("cash_movements"."type" = 'refund' and "cash_movements"."refund_id" is not null and "cash_movements"."order_id" is null and "cash_movements"."amount_paise" < 0) or ("cash_movements"."type" in ('cash_in', 'cash_out', 'deposit', 'adjustment') and "cash_movements"."order_id" is null and "cash_movements"."refund_id" is null)

cash_movements_manual_reason.name: cash_movements_manual_reason
cash_movements_manual_reason.value: "cash_movements"."type" in ('cod_collection', 'refund') or (nullif(btrim("cash_movements"."reason"), '') is not null and char_length("cash_movements"."reason") <= 1000)

cash_movements_manual_direction.name: cash_movements_manual_direction
cash_movements_manual_direction.value: ("cash_movements"."type" = 'cash_in' and "cash_movements"."amount_paise" > 0) or ("cash_movements"."type" in ('cash_out', 'deposit') and "cash_movements"."amount_paise" < 0) or "cash_movements"."type" not in ('cash_in', 'cash_out', 'deposit')

cash_session_closures_reversal_evidence.name: cash_session_closures_reversal_evidence
cash_session_closures_reversal_evidence.value: ("cash_session_closures"."reversed_at" is null and "cash_session_closures"."reversed_by" is null and "cash_session_closures"."reversal_reason" is null) or ("cash_session_closures"."reversed_at" is not null and "cash_session_closures"."reversed_by" is not null and nullif(btrim("cash_session_closures"."reversal_reason"), '') is not null)

cash_sessions_close_evidence.name: cash_sessions_close_evidence
cash_sessions_close_evidence.value: ("cash_sessions"."status" = 'open' and "cash_sessions"."counted_cash_paise" is null and "cash_sessions"."variance_paise" is null and "cash_sessions"."closed_by" is null and "cash_sessions"."closed_at" is null) or ("cash_sessions"."status" = 'closed' and "cash_sessions"."counted_cash_paise" is not null and "cash_sessions"."variance_paise" = "cash_sessions"."counted_cash_paise" - "cash_sessions"."expected_cash_paise" and "cash_sessions"."closed_by" is not null and "cash_sessions"."closed_at" is not null)

order_items_cost_snapshot_complete.name: order_items_cost_snapshot_complete
order_items_cost_snapshot_complete.value:
("order_items"."unit_cost_paise" is null and "order_items"."line_cost_paise" is null and "order_items"."cost_version_id" is null)
        or ("order_items"."unit_cost_paise" is not null and "order_items"."line_cost_paise" is not null and "order_items"."cost_version_id" is not null)

order_items_hsn_sac_code_present.name: order_items_hsn_sac_code_present
order_items_hsn_sac_code_present.value: "order_items"."hsn_sac_code" is null or nullif(btrim("order_items"."hsn_sac_code"), '') is not null

orders_tax_metadata_valid.name: orders_tax_metadata_valid
orders_tax_metadata_valid.value:
"orders"."tax_calculation_policy_version" > 0
        and "orders"."tax_is_demo" = true
        and "orders"."tax_disclaimer" = 'Portfolio demo — not a statutory tax invoice'
        and nullif(btrim("orders"."place_of_supply_state"), '') is not null

orders_delivery_tax_snapshot_valid.name: orders_delivery_tax_snapshot_valid
orders_delivery_tax_snapshot_valid.value:
"orders"."delivery_tax_rule_version" > 0
        and "orders"."delivery_tax_rate_bps" between 0 and 10000
        and "orders"."delivery_taxable_amount_paise" >= 0
        and "orders"."delivery_tax_paise" >= 0
        and "orders"."delivery_taxable_amount_paise"::bigint + "orders"."delivery_tax_paise"::bigint = "orders"."delivery_fee_paise"::bigint
        and nullif(btrim("orders"."delivery_hsn_sac_code"), '') is not null

disclaimer.name: disclaimer
disclaimer.default: 'Portfolio demo — not a statutory tax invoice'

tax_rules_disclaimer_exact.name: tax_rules_disclaimer_exact
tax_rules_disclaimer_exact.value: "tax_rules"."disclaimer" = 'Portfolio demo — not a statutory tax invoice'
